description: Store a new observation/memory. Automatically indexed for search. Use type to classify: gotcha ([GOTCHA] critical pitfall), decision ([DECISION] architecture choice), problem-solution ([FIX] bug fix), how-it-works ([INFO] explanation), what-changed ([CHANGE] change), discovery ([DISCOVERY] insight), why-it-exists ([WHY] rationale), trade-off ([TRADEOFF] compromise), session-request ([SESSION] original goal). Project visibility is the default. Personal or team visibility requires an explicitly joined coordination identity. Set longTerm only when the caller explicitly wants an additional source-backed long-term candidate; it is never injected until an operator records a review through the CLI. For a read-only task, do not store unless the user explicitly asks to save a record.

attachments.description: Safe public provenance references. They are stored as metadata for lexical retrieval; raw inline media is never stored.

url.description: Public HTTPS provenance reference without query parameters or fragments. Memorix does not fetch this URL: attachment metadata is persisted and BM25-searchable, while observation vectors remain text-only.

entityName.description: The entity this observation belongs to (e.g., "auth-module", "port-config")

longTerm.description: Optional explicit request to create a source-backed long-term candidate alongside this observation. Candidates are not automatically injected.

applicability.description: When this durable fact or procedure applies.

kind.description: Cognitive kind for an additional long-term candidate.

scope.description: Long-term scope. User capture is private source evidence and needs a bound agent identity.

tags.description: Small set of retrieval tags for the candidate.

overrideReadOnly.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks to save memory during a read-only or no-modification task.

relatedCommits.description: Git commit hashes this memory relates to (links ground truth ↔ reasoning)

relatedEntities.description: Other entity names this memory cross-references

topicKey.description: Optional topic identifier for upserts (e.g., "architecture/auth-model"). If an observation with the same topicKey already exists in this project, it will be UPDATED instead of creating a new one. Use memorix_suggest_topic_key to generate a stable key. Good for evolving decisions, architecture docs, etc.

visibility.description: Retrieval scope. Project is the normal shared default; personal/team require memorix_session_start with joinTeam=true.

name: memorix_store
title: Store Memory
